ai-image-gen.title: AI Image Gen Canvas
ai-image-gen.description: Bring your own key to generate images via OpenAI / Gemini, arrange results on a lineage canvas, reverse-engineer prompts with skill templates and export zips

toolbar.clearConfirmDesc: Deletes every cached image from IndexedDB. The prompt library is untouched. This cannot be undone.

gate.title: AI image generation is off
gate.body: Once enabled, your prompts and uploaded images are sent to the provider you configure. API keys stay in this browser's localStorage; there is no relay on our side.

params.seedUnsupported: The OpenAI image protocol has no seed; this only applies to Gemini.

image-stack.title: Image Stack
image-stack.description: Stack photos into grids or posters, or run them top to bottom into one super-long image (subtitle strips, scrolling-screenshot de-duplication), or slice a single photo into tiles: size, margins, gaps, radius and export format all adjustable, fully local.

notes.local: Every image is decoded and composited inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

upload.dropTitle: Drop images to start laying out
upload.dropSubtitle: Multi-select, drop a whole folder, or paste a screenshot
upload.pasteHint: You can also paste from the clipboard with Ctrl + V

export.alphaLost: JPG has no alpha; rounded corners and transparent areas are filled white
export.clipboardUnsupported: This browser cannot write images to the clipboard
export.failed: Export failed. Try another image or a smaller canvas.

long.hint: The strip order is the top-to-bottom order of the result — drag a thumbnail to move it.

presetHint.seamless: Keep every image whole and stack them at one width into a single long image.
presetHint.subtitle: The first image stays whole; each one after it keeps only a bottom band, the way movie quotes get stacked.
presetHint.screenshot: Keep everything and trim the repeated header off each image — made for scrolling screenshots.

long.keepBottomHint: The first image is always whole. 100% is a seamless long image.
long.widthModeHint: Nothing is ever enlarged: a narrower image keeps its own size and sits on the background.
long.dedupHint: The bottom rows of each image are compared with the top rows of the next one. Only confident matches are applied; anything unsure is reported instead of guessed.
long.dedupDone: Trimmed {{applied}} overlaps ({{px}} px); {{review}} to confirm, {{flat}} too flat to read

dedupReason.flat: Too flat (solid or gradient) to detect reliably
dedupReason.ambiguous: Repeating pattern — the result is unsure, check it yourself
dedupReason.weak: Low similarity, treat it as a suggestion

long.ignored: {{total}} images past the cap were left out
long.zoomHint: Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom · click the overview to jump
long.narrowFillHint: Only matters when widths differ: blur fill enlarges the image itself and lays it across the whole row.
long.stackOverlapHint: Each image slides up over the previous one; pair it with the shadow for the stacked-card look.
long.caption: Caption
long.captionTextHint: {n} is the index, {total} the count, {name} the file name
long.segments: Too tall for one canvas — exporting {{total}} segments split at the seams (max {{px}} px each)

long.unsplittable: {{total}} images are taller than the limit on their own — reduce the output width or swap them

gif-compressor.title: GIF Compressor
gif-compressor.description: Squeeze an animated GIF under a target size: search width, colour count and lossy strength against Slack, Discord or WeChat emoji limits, or dial them in by hand — entirely in your browser.
gif-compressor.drop-subtitle: or click to choose a file · paste from the clipboard · everything stays on your device
gif-compressor.error-invalid: This GIF could not be parsed — it may be corrupt or not animated.
gif-compressor.error-generic: Compression failed. Try another file or lighter settings.
gif-compressor.budget-width: Width exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — scale the GIF down first
gif-compressor.budget-height: Height exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — scale the GIF down first
gif-compressor.budget-frames: {{limit}} frames is the ceiling — shorten the clip or drop frames
gif-compressor.budget-seconds: {{limit}} seconds is the ceiling — trim a shorter range
gif-compressor.lossy-hint: 0 is lossless; higher saves bytes but can introduce blocks
gif-compressor.dither-hint: Smoother gradients, but a bigger file and a slower encode
gif-compressor.privacy-note: Your file is processed only inside your browser and never uploaded.
gif-compressor.result-empty: Pick your settings, then hit Compress.
gif-compressor.result-grew: The result is larger than the original — compare before you decide
gif-compressor.result-params: Output {{width}} px · {{colors}} colours · lossy {{lossy}} · {{rounds}} measured rounds

gif-maker.title: GIF Maker
gif-maker.description: Turn still images into an animated GIF: drop or paste pictures, then reorder frames, set a per-frame delay, loop count and matte colour — sizes are normalised automatically, entirely in your browser.
gif-maker.drop-subtitle: Click to browse, drag a whole folder, or paste from the clipboard · animated GIFs can't be used as a single frame
gif-maker.optimize-hint: Run the result through gifsicle -O3 for frame differencing
gif-maker.privacy-note: Your images are processed inside your browser and never uploaded.
gif-maker.error-build: Build failed. Try fewer images or a smaller output width.
gif-maker.budget-width: Output width exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — lower it
gif-maker.budget-height: Output height exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — lower the width
gif-maker.budget-frames: {{limit}} frames is the ceiling — remove some images
gif-maker.budget-seconds: {{limit}} seconds is the ceiling — use fewer frames or a lower frame rate
gif-maker.fill-hint: How an image that misses the canvas is handled
gif-maker.dither-hint: Smooths gradients with noise; slightly larger file
gif-maker.target-hint: Searches for settings that fit after building

gif-editor.title: GIF Editor
gif-editor.description: Edit an animated GIF frame by frame: delete, duplicate, reorder, set per-frame delays, reverse or boomerang, rotate, flip, resize, change the loop count, append a second GIF, or export every frame as a PNG — all local.
gif-editor.drop-subtitle: Frames are listed after decoding · paste from the clipboard works too · no pixel painting
gif-editor.width-hint: Shrinks only; after a 90° turn the long edge is what gets capped, so it can't break the height limit
gif-editor.optimize-hint: Run the export through gifsicle -O3 for frame differencing
gif-editor.speed-clamped: {{n}} frames hit the 2-centisecond floor; faster than this flickers
gif-editor.preview-note: What you see is what you export: {{width}}×{{height}} px · {{frames}} frames · {{seconds}}s
gif-editor.privacy-note: The GIF is processed inside your browser and never uploaded.
gif-editor.error-invalid: This GIF could not be parsed — it may be corrupt.
gif-editor.error-export: Export failed. Try fewer frames or a smaller output width.
gif-editor.budget-width: Output width exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — lower it
gif-editor.budget-height: Output height exceeds the {{limit}} px limit — lower the width
gif-editor.budget-frames: {{limit}} frames is the ceiling — delete some frames
gif-editor.budget-seconds: {{limit}} seconds is the ceiling — delete frames or shorten the delays
